title: DFS across connected components
summary: Group every vertex of an undirected graph using a fresh stack per component and one shared visited set. Supply neighbors for every vertex, including isolated ones.
triggers: partition an undirected graph into reachable groups
count disconnected groups including isolated vertices
prompts: Group machines into islands using only their direct cable connections.
A map lists all towns and two-way roads. Which groups can trade without crossing water?
invariant: Every vertex marked during one stack traversal belongs to the same component.
mantra: Start from each unseen vertex and finish its component.
pitfalls: Directed edges require a choice of weak or strong connectivity before applying a component algorithm.

anchors.name: Number of Provinces
anchors.trick: Count the traversal starts needed to reach all vertices.

mutations.explanation: Skips every new component before its first traversal can begin.

test: assert sorted(sorted(group) for group in components(graph)) == [[0, 1, 2], [3], [4, 5]]
